The Best Banana Bread (Easy & Moist!)

This is the banana bread I’ve made every week for ten years. Here’s why it works…

The Best Banana Bread

  • 3 ripe bananas, mashed
  • 1/3 cup unsalted butter, melted

Variations

For chocolate chip banana bread, leave out the walnuts and fold in 1 cup of chocolate chips.

Notes

Freeze slices wrapped in plastic wrap for up to 3 months.
